item.text:
{
  "dossier_id": "FICTIONAL-KAKHETI-OB-001",
  "version": "1.0",
  "transcript_header": "FICTIONAL INTERVIEW REHEARSAL. All hotel, guest, staff, operational records and transactions below are invented. No real property evidence, consent, verification or legal conclusion exists.",
  "interview_date": "2026-09-23",
  "respondent": {
    "role": "General Manager and operations lead",
    "property": "Fictional Vineyard Court, Kakheti",
    "rooms": 28,
    "voice": "Pragmatic, accountable for commercial policy, protective of staff, cautious about incomplete records."
  },
  "responsibilities": {
    "Front Desk/Night Auditor": "Records telephone and walk-in reservations in the shared PMS inventory, handles arrivals, checks exception reports and escalates accommodation conflicts.",
    "Revenue/GM": "Owns availability policy, pricing, relocation expenditure and disputed-charge follow-up.",
    "Channel Operations": "One daytime employee maintains room mappings, checks distribution records and reconciles channel availability. This is an internal responsibility, not an OTA department.",
    "external_systems": [
      "Booking.com",
      "Expedia",
      "Existing third-party distribution service"
    ]
  },
  "inventory_and_policy": {
    "model": "For this scenario, all 28 rooms are interchangeable standard doubles. Booking.com, Expedia and Direct draw against the same dated PMS pool; there are no separate OTA allotments.",
    "direct_handling": "Website reservations commit against local PMS availability. Telephone and walk-in bookings require a PMS reservation before confirmation. A local Direct commitment changes the shared pool, but does not lock inventory inside either OTA.",
    "last_direct_booking": "FICTIONAL DIRECT-0912-07 committed on 2026-09-11 at 21:03 +04:00, bringing committed rooms for 12 September to 27 and inventory to version 8421, available 1.",
    "commercial_choice": "The GM deliberately left both OTAs and Direct open with one physical room left, influenced by expected cancellations. There was no authorization to deliberately accept a 29th reservation.",
    "distinction": "Keeping several channels open near capacity was a conscious exposure decision. The resulting duplicate commitment was an accidental conflict, not a planned oversell.",
    "churn_cohort": {
      "record": "FICTIONAL COHORT-FC-AUG26, closed 2026-09-02",
      "definition": "All 100 unique free-cancellation reservation IDs scheduled to arrive during August 2026, across the three sales sources; reservation count, not room-night count. Date amendments retain their original ID.",
      "outcomes": {
        "cancelled_before_penalty": 38,
        "completed_stays": 62,
        "unresolved_or_no_show": 0
      },
      "interpretation": "38% is a fictional local retrospective estimate, recalled conversationally as roughly 35–40%. It is not a market statistic or the probability that a cancellation will rescue a particular sold-out Saturday.",
      "limitation": "The cohort is not restricted to last-room situations or peak Saturdays. It does not logically justify the chosen exposure."
    }
  },
  "incident": {
    "id": "FICTIONAL-INC-20260912-01",
    "stay": "2026-09-12 to 2026-09-13, ONE night",
    "context": "Peak harvest-weekend demand; 27 existing commitments, no out-of-order rooms and no subsequent cancellation freeing capacity.",
    "bookings": {
      "Booking.com": "F-BKG-912-A, one double, USD 200, prepaid through the fictional OTA payment arrangement; guest later relocated.",
      "Expedia": "F-EXP-912-B, one double, USD 200, prepaid through the fictional OTA payment arrangement; guest accommodated at the hotel."
    },
    "result": "29 commitments against 28 rooms. Twenty-eight parties stayed at the hotel; one party stayed at the competitor for one night."
  },
  "timing_and_record_limits": {
    "timezone": "Asia/Tbilisi, UTC+04:00; all operational timestamps below use this zone.",
    "clock_limits": "Mock local host clock checks bracket the incident within approximately ±2 seconds. OTA acceptance timestamps have whole-second resolution and an assumed fictional clock uncertainty of ±5 seconds each. These are dossier assumptions, not vendor guarantees.",
    "acceptance_gap": "The fictional OTA-origin confirmation records place acceptance 65 seconds apart; allowing the stated clock uncertainty gives approximately 55–75 seconds, still within 90 seconds.",
    "boundary": "OTA acceptance is distinct from callback arrival, local processing, stock transmission, acknowledgement and actual removal from sale. Acknowledgement does not establish consumer-facing closure.",
    "resolution": "No sub-second latency is claimed. Minute-resolution availability observations cannot establish a precise closure time."
  },
  "exact_mock_log_excerpts": [
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:10:00+04:00 | distribution export U-8421 | stay=2026-09-12 | local_inventory_version=8421 | available=1 | targets=Booking.com,Expedia",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:10:15+04:00 | OTA-origin acceptance record | Booking.com | booking=F-BKG-912-A | status=CONFIRMED | event=B-ACC-01",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:10:25+04:00 | local callback receipt | correlation=B-IN-01 | booking=F-BKG-912-A | source_event=B-ACC-01",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:10:28+04:00 | local processing committed | correlation=B-IN-01 | version=8422 | committed=28 | available=0 | Direct local sale closed",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:11:20+04:00 | OTA-origin acceptance record | Expedia | booking=F-EXP-912-B | status=CONFIRMED | event=E-ACC-01",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:11:30+04:00 | local callback receipt | correlation=E-IN-01 | booking=F-EXP-912-B | source_event=E-ACC-01",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:11:34+04:00 | local processing committed | correlation=E-IN-01 | version=8423 | committed=29 | physical_deficit=1 | advertised_available=0 | exception=OVER_CAPACITY",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:12:00+04:00 | outbound stock job U-8423 | local_version=8423 | intended_available=0 | Booking.com request=B-OUT-02 | Expedia request=E-OUT-02",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:12:06+04:00 | acknowledgement B-ACK-02 | request=B-OUT-02 | receipt accepted | consumer sellability not established",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12T00:12:09+04:00 | acknowledgement E-ACK-02 | request=E-OUT-02 | receipt accepted | consumer sellability not established",
    "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12 00:14 +04:00 | manual availability observation, minute resolution | both OTA listings unavailable for one double, 12–13 September | other rate plans and cached sessions not exhaustively checked"
  ],
  "technical_interpretation": {
    "update_interval": "The local export record shows two minutes between the 00:10 and 00:12 jobs. That is this fictional episode's interval, not an OTA SLA.",
    "direct_result": "Direct shared the exposure until local processing reduced stock to zero at 00:10:28. No Direct confirmation occurred during the race; subsequent local availability was zero.",
    "leading_explanation": "Both OTAs accepted a last-room booking before the scheduled zero-stock transmission. Human response could not make those independent acceptance operations atomic.",
    "unresolved_boundary": "The Expedia outbound payload bodies and detailed account-edit history from 00:09–00:15 are missing. The job ledger records intended stock and a local version association; it does not prove the exact external room/rate mapping or an externally enforced version.",
    "competing_explanation": "A stale mapping or manual availability edit could also have contributed to Expedia remaining sellable. Neither is established or excluded by the surviving mock records.",
    "staff_context": "The night auditor was assisting an in-house guest and read the exception at 00:19. That delayed recovery escalation; it did not explain the machine acceptance race."
  },
  "recovery": {
    "ownership": "Night Auditor escalated; GM owned alternative accommodation and spending; Channel Operations reviewed distribution records that morning.",
    "mock_recovery_entries": [
      "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12 00:23 +04:00 | GM notified; no internal room available.",
      "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12 09:10 +04:00 | alternative double confirmed at fictional competitor for one night, USD 260.",
      "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-12 09:25 +04:00 | fictional guest accepts alternative and transport without additional payment.",
      "FICTIONAL | 2026-09-13 11:00 +04:00 | relocated stay completed."
    ],
    "alternative_quality": "The fictional comparison sheet records equivalent double occupancy, private bathroom and breakfast. This is a scenario assessment, not independently verified quality.",
    "labor": "No active-task time sheet exists. Staff rework and its monetary cost remain unknown; elapsed timestamps are not labor measurements."
  },
  "fictional_financial_basis": {
    "conversion": "FICTIONAL transaction conversion schedule FX-F12: USD 1 = GEL 2.70; EUR 1 = GEL 3.00. Used consistently below solely for reconciliation. These are not real market rates.",
    "scope": "Amounts are final mock transaction totals. No additional tax, bank fee, telephone charge or unrecorded refund is assumed.",
    "original_guest_funds": "Booking.com collected USD 200, equivalent to GEL 540, on 12 September and refunded all USD 200 on 13 September. The hotel never received those funds in cash.",
    "replacement_payment": "Under the invented transaction arrangement, the OTA paid the competitor USD 260 and taxi USD 30, then invoiced the hotel. The hotel did not separately pay those suppliers."
  },
  "exact_mock_invoice": {
    "header": "FICTIONAL INVOICE F-REL-0914 | issued and received 2026-09-14 | case FICTIONAL-INC-20260912-01 | debtor Fictional Vineyard Court",
    "lines": [
      "One-night alternative accommodation, 12–13 September 2026 | USD 260.00 | FX-F12 | GEL 702.00",
      "Relocation taxi, 12 September 2026 | USD 30.00 | FX-F12 | GEL 81.00",
      "Claimed handling item | EUR 120.00 | FX-F12 | GEL 360.00"
    ],
    "total": "GEL 1,143.00",
    "status": "Entire invoice offset on 18 September; unpaid invoice balance GEL 0.00. The GEL 360.00 handling item remains disputed, with no credit issued by 23 September.",
    "meaning": "Cash settlement does not establish contractual validity. The invoice and its payout offset represent one charge, not two losses."
  },
  "exact_mock_booking_payout_statement": {
    "header": "FICTIONAL STATEMENT F-BPAY-0918 | issued 2026-09-18 | completed settlement period 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-15 | GEL",
    "lines": [
      "Other completed reservations: gross receipts +6,000.00",
      "Other completed reservations: commissions -900.00",
      "F-BKG-912-A original guest collection +540.00",
      "F-BKG-912-A guest refund -540.00",
      "F-BKG-912-A original commission posting -81.00",
      "F-BKG-912-A commission reversal credit +81.00",
      "Invoice F-REL-0914 offset -1,143.00",
      "Net transfer 3,957.00"
    ],
    "arrangement_limit": "This is an invented completed half-month payout, not an observed September month-end settlement or a claim about standard Booking.com payment arrangements."
  },
  "exact_mock_bank_and_expedia_records": [
    "FICTIONAL BANK RECEIPT F-BANK-0918 | value date 2026-09-18 | credit GEL 3,957.00 | reference F-BPAY-0918 | received",
    "FICTIONAL EXPEDIA STATEMENT F-EPAY-0920 | 2026-09-20 | F-EXP-912-B gross USD 200.00 / GEL 540.00 | commission USD 32.00 / GEL 86.40 | refund 0.00 | net GEL 453.60",
    "FICTIONAL BANK RECEIPT F-BANK-0921 | value date 2026-09-21 | credit GEL 453.60 | reference F-EPAY-0920 | received"
  ],
  "reconciliation_and_loss_limits": {
    "booking_payout": "6,000 - 900 + 540 - 540 - 81 + 81 - 1,143 = GEL 3,957.",
    "cash_status": "Both bank credits completed before the interview. No relocation invoice remains payable. The disputed handling charge has already reduced cash; potential recovery is unresolved.",
    "incident_cost": "Settled relocation-related expense is GEL 1,143, including disputed GEL 360. The original guest collection and refund cancel; the commission and reversal cancel.",
    "counterfactual": "Against a clean outcome retaining the Expedia booking and never accepting the conflicting Booking.com booking, the additional recorded expense is GEL 1,143. Expedia's GEL 540 gross receipt is ordinary last-room revenue, not automatically incremental compensation for that expense.",
    "limits": "This is a bounded transaction comparison, not total profit loss. No reputation cost, future revenue loss, labor valuation or guaranteed dispute recovery is quantified."
  },
  "contractual_uncertainty": {
    "manager_recollection": "I remember people calling it 'Clause 6', but I cannot authenticate our applicable signed terms or the basis for EUR 120.",
    "public_context": "The supplied public check identifies relocation obligations in clause 2.6.1 and indemnification matters in section 6, including 6.2.1. Its alternative-accommodation response windows are not inventory synchronization guarantees.",
    "handling_item": "The supplied retrieved text establishes neither a universal EUR 120 handling tariff nor automatic payout deduction for that specific item. Our invented invoice and offset do not establish either rule.",
    "legal_status": "Applicable signed agreement, payment authority and enforceability are unavailable. No legal conclusion is made."
  },
  "actually_used_control_and_comparison": {
    "control": "Exclusive Direct last-room sale, implemented manually for the following peak Saturday. GM owns release; Channel Operations closes OTA availability; Front Desk confirms the remaining room through the shared PMS.",
    "mock_record": "FICTIONAL CTRL-0919: On 2026-09-18, with 26 commitments for 19 September, both OTAs were closed. Closure checks were recorded before two remaining rooms were released exclusively through Direct.",
    "completed_outcome": "For 19–20 September, Direct sold both remaining rooms; 28 parties stayed, no conflicting confirmation and no relocation occurred.",
    "limitations": "One comparable peak Saturday supports operational feasibility, not a measured prevention rate. Booking pressure and timing differed; lost OTA demand is unknown. The control reduces cross-channel exposure but does not create a distributed lock."
  },
  "stable_boundaries": [
    "Reveal dossier details progressively in subsequent interview answers; retain these identifiers and amounts.",
    "No real records or consent exist.",
    "No API connector was implemented for this exercise.",
    "No stock reservation lock across OTAs, replay benchmark, measured hedge latency, integration test, future trial or guaranteed recovery advantage exists.",
    "Do not convert missing records into certainty or public market context into evidence of this fictional hotel's operations."
  ]
}
